agents.name: Health Advisor
agents.description: An agent that helps with first advice on different symptoms. It demonstrates on how to ask for information in a topic and the summarizes them in a flow using using an ai capability
agents.whatItDoes: First responder for health questions. It collects age, gender and symptoms, has a flow summarize them with a prompt, advises a doctor unless the outcome clears light work, explains protein types, resolves a colleague's email address and posts the case to Teams after an approval. It answers from two Word documents on fasting and traveling with health issues and serves Business Travel Planner as its symptom checker.
